Wireless CarPlay (Bluetooth bridge and Wi-Fi sessions)
Wireless CarPlay: retry a stuck start
settings.description: If no CarPlay session starts 8 s after the iPhone's Bluetooth start, the hotspot restarts once; after 40 s the attempt ends so the next one can start. After Enhanced Phone Projection.

settings.title: Wireless CarPlay ends with the car
settings.description: At delay mode or off, wireless CarPlay ends and doesn't start again until the car is on.

settings.description: A hook in the Settings app (no files changed). US/Canada only; other regions keep the stock choice.

settings.title: USB drives and hubs don't start wired Android Auto
settings.description: A hook in the Android Auto app (no files changed). Without it, a USB drive can block wireless Android Auto until the head unit restarts.
